person: Pablo Armando LERENA — in South Africa also Robert/Roberto Paul Lerena; registered LERINA at death
died_place: 7 Forth Road, Newlands, Wynberg district, Cape Town
evidence: IDENTITY: Argentine passport Serie A No. 07962 (1940) gives Pablo Armando Lerena, b. Rosario 22 Feb 1882, Trainer, of Rugby, widower. Corpus Christi Wynberg baptism register names PABLO ARMANDO LERENA and MARY SEPTIMA (olim TAYLOR) as parents of Roque Luis Armando b. 25 Nov 1905 - the same son whose 1973 death notice gives the parents as "Roberto Lerena and Mary Septima Lerena". ONE MAN. DEATH: Union of SA death certificate A 214036, entry W612/50, "Robert Paul LERINA", RACE HORSE OWNER, widower, d. 19 Mar 1950, buried Maitland Cemetery no 1. The age of 76 on that certificate is WRONG - he was 68; the informant W. Fraser was not family.

Maiden name TAYLOR documented by "olim Taylor" in the Corpus Christi baptism register. Burial: Maitland Road Cemetery interment register p.3215 entry 163, Nov 1935, aged 51, Roman Catholic, Cemetery no 1, grave 7719A. Named as mother in the 1911 baptism and in Roque's 1973 death notice.

spouse: Catherine Mary Sophia Booyzen (1929-2013), m. Johannesburg
evidence: Named as a "major son" and residuary heir with this exact birth date in his father's 1950 estate (Letters of Administration 1847/50). Own death notice, estate 6746/71: ID 331 406051W, Salesman, of 24 Leiden Road, Gerdview, Germiston.

spouse: m.1 Derrick Luwinski (b.1947); m.2 Ivan Defranceski (b.1951, Senj, Croatia)
evidence: Named as "Cheryl Ann Lerena, minor" among the children in her father's 1971 death notice. Details withheld per living-persons rule.
